title: Personal Service Health Weekly Repair Time Trend
dataSources: Life service health (`lifeos:service`), personal scorecards (`lifeos:score`), breach notifications (`hibp:breach`), location visits (`location:visit`), runbook checklists (`runbook:checklist`), and Home Assistant outage events (`homeassistant:event`).
app: Apple and Google location exports, Have I Been Pwned breach alerts, Todoist-style personal runbooks, and Home Assistant outage events streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:service repair_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(repair_minutes) as avg_duration, max(repair_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst repair time for personal service health events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture repair_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average repair time with markers for the worst week.

references.title: Have I Been Pwned API v3

grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether personal service health tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
